subject: POC activation orchestrator: MAP items and close cadence
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: MedSync DevOps <devops@medsync.ai>, Rachel Lee <rachel.lee@medsync.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC activation orchestrator: MAP items and close cadence

Hi Rachel / DevOps team,

Thanks again for the productive demo last week. To keep momentum and hit your goal of a production-like evaluation by the second week of August, I'm proposing a short mutual action plan (MAP) focused solely on environment enablement items we need to close before provisioning:

High-level MAP items (proposed owners & target dates)
- Org and tenant seed (owner: MedSync/DevOps) — request org invite + initial tenant ID by Wed 2026-08-04
- API keys & scoped service account (owner: Redwood + MedSync) — generate API key pair and exchange by Thu 2026-08-05
- IP allowlist (owner: MedSync) — specify CIDR ranges; Redwood will provide egress IPs by Thu 2026-08-05
- VPC peering (owner: MedSync infra / Redwood infra) — confirm VPC ID and peering window; target peer by Mon 2026-08-10

Concrete next steps for this thread:
1) I attached a short draft MAP with checklist and owners (MAP-draft-v1.pdf). Please skim and mark any items you want changed.
2) DevOps: can you share the ephemeral range and the primary infra contact for peering? If you prefer a call, we can do a 20m slot today.
3) Procurement: we'll need to understand any PO timing for reserved capacity if you expect Dedicated testing.

If everyone agrees, Neha will lock the timeline and Ben will push the VPC template to you.

Thanks — looking to keep this tight so your eval can exercise real traffic.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: MAP-draft-v1.pdf
From: MedSync DevOps <devops@medsync.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Rachel Lee <rachel.lee@medsync.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC activation orchestrator: MAP items and close cadence

Kimberly — thanks for the clear plan. Quick answers from our side:
- Org/tenant: we'll create the evaluation tenant and send invite to kimberly_park@redwood.com and ben_carter@redwood.com by EOD today.
- IP ranges: our infra team needs to confirm a /24 for the load balancer plus two /28s for internal services; we can share exact CIDRs by tomorrow morning.
- VPC peering: we'd like to follow Redwood's peering template — can Ben share the required route table and IAM scope?

We do prefer a short 20m sync to confirm ports and whether NAT is required. Available windows: today 15:00–16:00 PT or tomorrow 09:00–10:00 PT.

Also looping in procurement (procurement@medsync.ai) — if Dedicated is on the table for this trial, we'll flag budget and PO timing.

Cheers,
Alex Martinez (on behalf of MedSync DevOps)
MedSync AI — Infrastructure
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: MedSync DevOps <devops@medsync.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC activation orchestrator: MAP items and close cadence

Allocating resources on our side — thanks Alex. I've attached a lightweight VPC peering template and a minimal IAM scope example. The template shows:
- required CIDR allowances (we only use 10.0.0.0/16 within our trial infra)
- route propagation steps
- a sample security-group rule set for the inference endpoints (ports 443 + ephemeral 1024-65535 for callbacks when using private webhook flows)

If you want me to open a PR to modify the template with your VPC IDs, I can. Otherwise, supply CIDRs and VPC IDs and I'll produce a peering request we can both submit.

Attachments: vpc-peering-template.json

Thanks everyone — summarizing the agreed MAP and the close cadence so there's a single reference:

Agreed MAP items & owners
- Tenant invite & org seed — MedSync (target: 2026-08-03 EOD)
- API keys & service-account — Redwood + MedSync (target: 2026-08-05)
- IP allowlist (CIDRs) — MedSync (target: 2026-08-04 AM)
- VPC peering request submitted — Ben (Redwood) once MedSync supplies VPC IDs (target: 2026-08-06)
- Test-run & smoke tests (short script) — Redwood to deliver smoke script; MedSync to run and report by 2026-08-09

Close window: both teams agreed to attempt environment activation and first traffic by 2026-08-10. If procurement needs to delay Dedicated capacity, we'll still proceed on Hosted with the same MAP items but may adjust the scale.

Attachments for reference: credentials-checklist.csv (fields we need from your side), MAP-draft-v1.pdf, vpc-peering-template.json
Related links:
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567
- DocuSign (SOW placeholder): https://www.docusign.com/link/MS-2026-47

Action items for MedSync (short):
1) Send tenant invite to kimberly_park@redwood.com and ben_carter@redwood.com by EOD today.
2) Provide CIDR blocks + VPC IDs by 2026-08-04 AM.
3) Confirm whether procurement prefers Hosted evaluation first or immediate Dedicated trial.

I'll follow up with a calendar invite for a 20m sync at 15:30 PT today unless you ask for a different slot.

Neha Kapoor
